description: Visual separation between content groups, with optional orientation and label.

howToUse: Use it to separate groups of content that have no title of their own, such as blocks in a menu or a form.
Use `label` for a choice between paths ("or"), and `orientation="vertical"` between items on one line.
alternatives: A group with a name: SectionHeader.
Space alone separates well enough: no divider.

keyboard.action: The divider does not receive focus.

props.name: label
props.description:
Optional center label (e.g. "or"). Only makes sense horizontally;
ignored when vertical.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Outer margin along the flow axis (default: "md").

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
